arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, requests, io
base='https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/sdmx/2.1/data/TRAN_SF_RAILSU'
url=base+'/.?time=2014,2020&format=SDMX-CSV&compressed=false'
text=requests.get(url,timeout=60).text
# load
from io import StringIO
df=pd.read_csv(StringIO(text))
# filter
geos={'DE','BE','PT','ES','UK','FR','HR','BG'}
df=df[(df['unit']=='NR') & (df['geo'].isin(geos)) & (df['TIME_PERIOD'].isin([2014,2020]))]
# pivot
p=df.pivot_table(index='geo',columns='TIME_PERIOD',values='OBS_VALUE',aggfunc='first')
# compute decrease percent
res=[]
for geo,row in p.iterrows():
    v14=row.get(2014)
    v20=row.get(2020)
    if pd.isna(v14) or pd.isna(v20) or v14==0: continue
    dec=(v14-v20)/v14*100
    if dec<45:
        res.append((geo,dec,v14,v20))
print(res)
PY
